name: Deep Fried Meme
summary: Deep Fried Meme is a meme aesthetic and format that emerged in the mid-to-late 2010s.
description: Deep Fried Meme is a meme aesthetic and format that emerged in the mid-to-late 2010s. It is defined by the intentional degradation of image quality through excessive filters, saturation, and compression, resulting in a "crunchy," high-contrast, and visually abrasive appearance. [ 1 ] While originally a meme format for surreal humor, the aesthetic is historically significant as a precursor to the "data degradation" visuals found in 2020s aesthetics like Goreweb and Haunted Mound .
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Irony, noise, absurdity, digital decay, anti-censorship
